instruction: Slightly turn left and walk straight you can find a table with number of chairs, left to it is a music instrument, right to the music instrument you can find a passage and there are two portraits on the wall at the left side, enter into that passage walk straight you can find a round table with number of chairs at the left side, and a pillar in front go near to the first pillar, you will find your destination at the back of the table and in front of the pillar.
